tagline: Bavaria's capital pairs beer-hall tradition with big tech and art museums — where Oktoberfest meets a surf wave on the Eisbach.
overview: Munich runs on two speeds: lederhosen-and-lager tradition and a modern powerhouse of BMWs, tech jobs and world-class museums. The Marienplatz's glockenspiel still chimes over a Gothic New Town Hall while the Viktualienmarkt feeds the city a few steps away.

The English Garden is the city's green heart — bigger than Central Park, home to a Chinese Tower beer garden and the Eisbach wave, where surfers ride a standing river wave in wetsuits all year. Museum Island Munich isn't a thing — but the Kunstareal quarter packs the Old, New and Modern Pinakothek into a walkable grid.

Speed's 2024 Europe tour streamed from Munich to huge German crowds. Every autumn the city hosts Oktoberfest — 6 million visitors, 7 million litres of beer and 250 years of tradition in one tent city.

funFacts.title: THE WORLD'S BIGGEST FEST
funFacts.text: Oktoberfest draws about 6 million visitors who drink some 7 million litres of beer.

funFacts.title: RIVER SURFING
funFacts.text: Surfers ride the Eisbach's standing wave at the English Garden's edge — illegal until 2010, now iconic.

funFacts.title: A PARK BIGGER THAN CENTRAL PARK
funFacts.text: The English Garden covers 375 hectares — one of the world's largest urban parks.

funFacts.title: GLOCKENSPIEL CLOCK
funFacts.text: The New Town Hall's glockenspiel re-enacts a 1568 royal wedding twice daily.

funFacts.title: BMW CITY
funFacts.text: The BMW Welt and museum sit by the Olympic Park — the company's HQ towers over them.

funFacts.title: OKTOBERFEST IS IN SEPTEMBER
funFacts.text: Most of the festival happens in late September — only its finale spills into October.

funFacts.title: THE WHITE SAUSAGE RULE
funFacts.text: Locals say Weisswurst must never hear noon church bells — eat it before midday.

funFacts.title: A CITY OF BEER GARDENS
funFacts.text: Munich counts over 100 beer gardens; the Hirschgarten seats 8,000.

funFacts.title: OLYMPIC LEGACY
funFacts.text: The 1972 Olympic Park's tent-roof stadium still hosts concerts and a roof climb.

funFacts.title: FOOTBALL ROYALTY
funFacts.text: Bayern Munich, Germany's most successful club, plays at the glowing Allianz Arena.
